description: Search the Cookwala catalog by words in titles, tags, cuisine or collection. Filters are ANDed, including no_allergens and diabetic_friendly (inferred, not medical advice). Returns summaries with hashes; use get_recipe for the document.

allergen_free.description: Exclude recipes declaring any of these allergens, for example milk

course.description: Course, for example main, dessert, breakfast

cuisine.description: ISO country codes, for example EG

diabetic_friendly.description: Only recipes that look diabetic-friendly: a reviewed claim, or per serving sugar 5 g or less and carbohydrate 30 g or less (modelled estimate, not medical advice).

lang.description: Language code, for example en or ar

level.description: Verification level: V0 described only, not machine-verified; V1 machine-checkable steps with end conditions and hazards, reviewed (structure, not a cooking or nutrition guarantee); V2 V1 plus conformance evidence from a certified executor

no_allergens.description: Only recipes with no major allergen in the declared list or the ingredient names. Not a guarantee: allergen data is incomplete for some recipes.

offset.description: Results to skip, for paging; use nextOffset from the previous page

query.description: Words that must all appear; empty lists everything

tags.description: Tags that must all be present, for example vegetarian

name: search_recipes

items.description: Recipe summaries with id, title, hash, level

nextOffset.description: Offset for the next page, absent on the last

title: Search recipes
